task_instruction: Finish the Explosion hierarchy so the ArcingChunks emitter works as wanted: set ArcingChunks to one_shot, lifetime 3s, randomness about 0.7, give it a QuadMesh draw pass and a StandardMaterial3D billboard with bright emission, and drive it with a ParticleProcessMaterial that fires from the default spread at 8–12 m/s, enables rigid collision with bounce 1.0, uses collision_use_scale, and sets a constant sub emitter frequency of 100 Hz with the sub_emitter path pointing to ../ArcingChunkSmoke. Add the GPUParticlesCollisionBox3D named ArcingChunkCollision, positioned just below the emitter and scaled to 40×1×40 so debris collides as shown in the collision segment of the video. Configure ArcingChunkSmoke to emit ~1000 particles with a ShaderMaterial referencing res://assets/shaders/SmokeShader.gdshader (NoiseTexture = res://assets/shaders/NoiseResource.tres) and a ParticleProcessMaterial that rotates sprites, uses the warm gradient/curve combo from the repo, lifetime 3 s, gravity (0,1,0), linear accel ~2, scale curve peaks between 8 and 15, and turbulence influence about 0.005–0.01 so the smoke puffs appear along the chunk trails.
author_astra_first_failure: ArcingChunks must use a StandardMaterial3D override
local_official_message: ArcingChunks must use a StandardMaterial3D override

+	// Face the camera while retaining the particle's size and sprite rotation.
+	float angle = INSTANCE_CUSTOM.x;
+	float c = cos(angle);
+	float s = sin(angle);
+	mat4 sprite_rotation = mat4(vec4(c, s, 0.0, 0.0), vec4(-s, c, 0.0, 0.0),
+		vec4(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0), vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0));
+	mat4 billboard = mat4(INV_VIEW_MATRIX[0], INV_VIEW_MATRIX[1], INV_VIEW_MATRIX[2], MODEL_MATRIX[3]);
+	mat4 particle_scale = mat4(vec4(length(MODEL_MATRIX[0].xyz), 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
+		vec4(0.0, length(MODEL_MATRIX[1].xyz), 0.0, 0.0),
+		vec4(0.0, 0.0, length(MODEL_MATRIX[2].xyz), 0.0), vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0));
+	mat4 particle_model = billboard * sprite_rotation * particle_scale;
+	MODELVIEW_MATRIX = VIEW_MATRIX * particle_model;
+	MODELVIEW_NORMAL_MATRIX = mat3(VIEW_MATRIX * billboard * sprite_rotation);
+	world_position = (particle_model * vec4(VERTEX, 1.0)).xyz;
+	world_position.y += TIME * TimeScale;
+	world_position *= NoiseScale;
 	
 	float displacement = texture(NoiseTexture, world_position).r * DisplacementScale;
 	VERTEX += NORMAL * (displacement - (DisplacementScale / 2.0));

+extends SceneTree
+
+func _initialize():
+	print("Collision enum: ", ParticleProcessMaterial.COLLISION_RIGID)
+	print("Constant sub-emission enum: ", ParticleProcessMaterial.SUB_EMITTER_CONSTANT)
+	print("Billboard particle enum: ", BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_PARTICLES)
+	var material = ParticleProcessMaterial.new()
+	for property in material.get_property_list():
+		var name = property.name
+		if "sub_emitter" in name or "collision" in name or "angle" in name or "angular_velocity" in name or "particle_flag" in name or "turbulence" in name or name == "direction" or name == "spread":
